rollback.cmd: oc delete deployment notes -n academy-lesson-e-storage --ignore-not-found && oc delete pod ghost -n academy-lesson-e-storage --ignore-not-found --wait=false && oc delete pvc notes-data typo-data -n academy-lesson-e-storage --ignore-not-found --timeout=240s

pvs=$(oc get pv -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.claimRef.namespace == "academy-lesson-e-storage") | .metadata.name') || exit 1
for pv in $pvs; do
  oc patch pv "$pv" -p '{"spec":{"persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy":"Delete"}}' || exit 1
  for i in $(seq 24); do
    left=$(oc get pv "$pv" --ignore-not-found -o name) || exit 1
    test -z "$left" && break
    sleep 5
  done
  left=$(oc get pv "$pv" --ignore-not-found -o name) || exit 1
  if [ -n "$left" ]; then oc delete pv "$pv" --timeout=60s || exit 1; fi
done

verify.cmd:
pvs=$(oc get pv -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.claimRef.namespace == "academy-lesson-e-storage") | .metadata.name') || exit 1
test -z "$pvs"

found=$(oc get namespace academy-x-stor-debug --ignore-not-found -o name) || exit 1
